about_the_game:
Mazey Village – A Cozy Adventure Awaits 🌿

A tornado has torn through a peaceful village, leaving the villagers with broken homes and their precious belongings scattered across the maze-like land.

As a skilled maze navigator, it's up to you to explore, recover what was lost, and help rebuild the town into something even better than before!

Explore a World Full of Hidden Treasures ✨

Journey through forests, ruins, and snowy landscapes, retrieving lost items and meeting charming creatures along the way. Every path leads to new discoveries, friendly faces, and maybe even a few surprises.

  • Search for lost belongings hidden throughout the mazey world.

  • Befriend villagers and quirky talking animals.

  • Meet tiny critters who might just lend a helping hand.

Rebuild and Customize the Village 🏡

Design the town by placing decorations and shaping its layout, creating a cozy space that matches your style.

  • Restore homes and welcome villagers back.

  • Decorate with furniture, gardens, and charming details.

  • Watch the village flourish as you bring the community together!

A Charming World Full of Life 🐮

From petting cows and penguins to uncovering hidden stories, Mazey Village is full of little moments that make every step of the adventure special. Help the villagers, make new friends, and bring warmth back to the town.

Are you ready to begin your journey? The village is waiting for you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8.1/10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3200g or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GTX 560 (2GB)/AMD Radeon 7850 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
